reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Caffeine before a race is a real performance tool, but I'm not going to put a dose number on pills. Strength and dose depend on your body weight, how much caffeine you already take in, and your heart and stomach tolerance, and a doctor or sports dietitian can give you a safe figure for you. What I can help with is race-day practice: try your intake in a few long runs so there are no surprises on the day, and keep it well clear of the start line in case it upsets your stomach. Want me to work the race into your training?"}
